title: In The Abandoned Village
paragraphs: This is a tough situation. The older sister of Big Sister has a keen sense for detecting concealment skills. This means I’ll need to cast even more concealment magic and increase the intensity.
“Who are you?!”
Father raised his shield and shouted at the older sister of Big Sister, heightening his caution.
“Isn’t that my line? This is the village where I used to live. Who are you, traveler?”
“…You live in such a ruined village? Also, if you understand me, then you’re not… a monster, right?”
“I suffered damage from the waves… haven’t you heard of beastmen?”
“Beastmen… ah, so such a race exists in this world.”

The older sister of Big Sister walked confidently toward Father and continued talking at a certain distance. For Father, who’s distrustful of people, it’s difficult for anyone to get that close, but I suppose being the older sister of Big Sister makes this possible?
“This world? You’re a rather unusual traveler.”
The older sister of Big Sister chuckled cheerfully.
“…Yeah, I never wanted to end up in this world. I don’t even want to know about it!”
Father spat out his reply.
“My name’s Sadeena, traveler. What brought you to this village?”
“Nothing in particular… I was fishing along the coast and found this abandoned village, so I thought I’d camp here.”
“Oh… you have to be careful though, there are still monsters around here.”
“…I guess I’ll thank you.”
“By the way, what’s your name, fisherman?”

The older sister of Big Sister asked Father for his name several times. Father, noticing that her voice sounded feminine but her appearance was far from human, seemed to be easing up on his caution a little.
“Naofumi Iwatani… Naofumi is my name.”
“I see, so your name is Naofumi, huh. So you came here to fish?”
“…Yeah.”

After a moment of thought, Father nodded. It almost seemed like he was trying to lie, but I don’t think it would work on the older sister of Big Sister. She gently took a sip from a bottle of alcohol, then glanced at Father before sitting down by the campfire.
“Ah, there’s something nostalgic about sitting around a fire in a village.”
“So, why did this village become abandoned?”
“Don’t you know, Naofumi? It was because of the wave damage.”
“…I thought as much.”

Father and the older sister of Big Sister continued their conversation calmly. Then, as a gesture of gratitude, Father began cooking the fish he had caught and offered it to the older sister of Big Sister. She accepted it without refusal and started eating.
“Cheers to our meeting!”
“Yeah, cheers.”
It seems that Father declined the drink offered by the older sister of Big Sister, but he continued chatting with her.
“…Sadeena, you don’t know about it, do you?”
“About what?”

The older sister of Big Sister tilted her head. This question likely had a hidden purpose in Father’s mind. It was probably about the rumors of the rapist who was supposedly infamous across the country.
“…If you don’t know, then forget it. But why are you so casually eating and drinking here?”
“Why not? It’s a special meeting after all.”
“Yeah, yeah. You won’t fool me that easily!”
Father became much more cautious. Ah, if he hadn’t helped back then, he wouldn’t have this cold expression now. Father… I’m sorry, even though you were only fulfilling a request.
Also… I didn’t know the older sister of Big Sister was here.
“You’re really cautious, huh? It seems like you’re here to fish, but do you only eat the fish you catch?”
“What does it matter if I know that?”
“I just thought something seemed different, so I asked.”
The older sister of Big Sister kept pushing Father with casual chatter.
“Nothing special… I just sell the fish and turn it into money.”
Father looked somewhat frustrated, but perhaps realizing that traveling at night was dangerous, he answered despite his irritation.
“Well, I used to be a fisherman too, so I know how it is. If you’re going to sell them…”
The older sister of Big Sister found an opening in the conversation and began speaking more familiarly with Father.
“Do you know any high-value fish? I was thinking of catching some to sell.”
“Oh? Should I catch some for you?”
“I’m not paying you for it.”
“No worries, I’ll do it for free. But in exchange, I’d like you to tell me what you’d do with the money once you get it.”
“…Hmm.”
Father paused to think.
“I just want to buy some equipment.”
“Equipment? Like weapons or something?”
The older sister of Big Sister directed her gaze at Father’s shield. In response, Father seemed to hide the shield.
“…I don’t want to talk.”
“You’re suspicious, aren’t you?”
“That’s my business. You’ve been annoying since earlier!”
“Oh, I see… Well then, as promised, I’ll go get it. Be careful, though, the monsters might still come.”
Saying that, the older sister of Big Sister cheerfully went toward the coast. She swam off.
“What the hell is she… seriously?”
Father muttered this, then started preparing for bed. About 30 minutes later, the older sister of Big Sister returned with an expensive fish and placed it in front of Father.
“Here. The fish, as promised.”
“Ah, yeah…”
“Oh? Are you going to sleep? Should I keep watch for you?”
“You’re planning to steal from me, aren’t you?”
Father responded with an unusually strong sense of caution.
“Steal what?”
“Lots of things, like clothes, my bag, my fishing gear!”
“Oh, I see… Well, I’ll sleep first, so why don’t you keep watch, Naofumi-chan?”

Saying that, the older sister of Big Sister lay down and began to sleep. She was completely relaxed and unguarded. Father gave her a look of disbelief. In this manner, Father stayed awake, and the sun rose in the morning.
“You’ll collapse if you don’t sleep.”
“Shut up.”
The older sister of Big Sister seemed to be following Father.
“Don’t follow me!”
“Of course I’m worried about you.”
“Ugh…”
With a frustrated expression, Father continued dealing with the older sister of Big Sister. A unique atmosphere seemed to have developed during the night.
“Hey, hey, Naofumi-chan. Since we met here, it’s fate. How about we go sea fishing together? I’ll handle the monsters for you.”
She pointed at a small boat and invited Father.
“You’re planning to get me on the boat and dump me to kill me, aren’t you?”
“I don’t have any such plans. Oh?”
At that moment, a few monsters called Moss Green Wolves appeared. Father entered battle stance.
“Naofumi-chan, since we’re going to fight anyway, we might as well party up. You don’t want to waste the experience, right?”
The older sister of Big Sister replied, holding a harpoon.
“Huh?”
“Should I be the leader, or do you want to be, Naofumi-chan? Either way, I’ll end it quickly, so it’s better if I take the lead.”

She said that and likely sent a party request to Father. This is bad! If I’m here, Father won’t get any experience, and things will get complicated. It can’t be helped. With the older sister of Big Sister here, it should be fine. I cast the Portal Spear and temporarily withdrew.
